text:
rajiv: thinking out loud — proposing a pulsed sampling approach for SLO alerts. instead of firing every tenant alert continuously, we emit a small number of pulses per window and pick tenants by a weight (priority + recent regression score). should cut noise and still catch regressions. anyone see obvious gaps?

tess: interesting. main ops concern is deterministic routing so oncall sees the same thing across replicas.

kevin: how do you compute the weight? is it tunable per-customer? any example config?

rajiv: simple config sketch:
```
sampling:
  window: 5m
  pulses: 3
  weight_by:
    tenant_priority: 0.6
    regression_score: 0.4
  decay: 0.5 
  min_pulses_per_tenant: 1
```

marie: that looks reasonable. concern: historical noisy tenants will dominate because of accumulated regression_score — add recency decay (looks like you have decay but verify the math). also consider a cap to avoid starving low-priority tenants.

rajiv: yep, decay is per-window exponential with alpha=0.5 by default. also plan a hard cap so a tenant never gets > 50% of pulses.

kevin: how will this show up in the console? developers will ask "why didn't I get an alert". we need transparent UX for sampled vs omitted alerts.

tess: agree — console should expose a per-tenant "alert visibility" timeline and a debug mode that explains sample decisions. plus an admin override to force full fanout per-SLO.

rajiv: from telemetry POV: emit events with tags `sampled` or `omitted` and `reason=<weight|cap|low_priority|rate_limit>`. also log the pulse id for correlation with traces.

deploy-bot: Sampling service v0.3 deployed to staging at 1945678905 :rocket: (tests passed)

marie: runbook note: if omitted but error_budget_burn spikes (eg >5x baseline for 5m), bypass sampling and fanout immediately. otherwise we risk missing fast regressions.

rajiv: agreed. bypass rule: burn_rate > 5x baseline for 5m OR absolute error_budget_burn > 1% over window -> immediate fanout. will add unit/integration tests.

kevin: I can mock telemetry and add a dashboard widget that shows sampled pulse hits and omitted counts per-tenant. will do a PR against metrics repo. @tess can you design the console flag/ux?

tess: on it. i'll post a mock in #design later today.

rajiv: thanks all — i'll land a short proposal doc with config options, default params, and test plan. pinging @kevin when PRs land for dashboard wiring.
